events.content:
View transitions are wired up across the gallery using React's `ViewTransition` component and the browser View Transitions API.

### Shared element morph (grid → detail)
Product thumbnails and detail hero images share a `name` (`product-${slug}`) with `share="morph"`, so the colored image block morphs between grid cell and detail hero on navigation.

### Directional page slides
- Forward navigation (`Link` to product) uses `transitionTypes={['nav-forward']}`
- Back navigation uses `transitionTypes={['nav-back']}`
- Both pages wrap content in `PageTransition`, which maps those types to left/right slide animations

### Suspense reveals
Skeleton fallbacks exit with `slide-down`; loaded content enters with `slide-up`, on both the home grid and product detail info panel.

### Reduced motion
A `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` media query disables all view transition animations and skeleton pulse animations.

### Files changed
- `app/components/PageTransition.tsx` — reusable directional navigation wrapper
- `app/ProductGrid.tsx` — shared element + forward navigation tags
- `app/page.tsx` — page transition + Suspense reveal
- `app/product/[slug]/page.tsx` — shared element, back navigation, page transition, Suspense reveal
- `app/globals.css` — morph, slide, fade keyframes and reduced-motion overrides

Run `npm run dev` and click between the grid and product pages to see the morph and directional slides. The detail page's async content (100ms delay) shows the skeleton-to-content handoff.
